perguntas.why: Passado antes do passado → had left.

perguntas.q: By the time we arrived, the movie ___.
perguntas.why: Passado antes do passado → had + particípio.

perguntas.q: I ___ never seen snow before that trip.
perguntas.why: Antes de um ponto no passado → had.
I had seen, she had gone.

perguntas.q: They were tired because they ___ all day.
perguntas.why: Causa anterior no passado → had been + ING.

perguntas.why: Put off = adiar. Put on = vestir.
Give up = desistir. Get up = levantar.
Aqui "to" é preposição, então o verbo vai com -ING.
Look after the kids = cuidar das crianças.
